<details>
This PKGBUILD follows standard AUR packaging practices for a git-based package. The source originates from the package's own upstream GitHub repository (`git+https://github.com/SHORiN-KiWATA/screenrec-menu.git`), which is expected behavior. The `sha256sums` is set to `SKIP`, which is required and normal for VCS sources per Arch packaging guidelines. The `pkgver()` function uses standard git commands (`git rev-list`, `git rev-parse`) to generate the version string. The `package()` function installs two files (`shorin-screenrec-menu` and `drawbox.py`) to standard locations (`$pkgdir/usr/bin/` and `$pkgdir/usr/share/shorin-screenrec-menu/`) using `install -Dm755`, which is routine. Dependencies include standard tools for a Wayland screen recording menu (bash, slurp, wl-clipboard, ffmpeg, Python/GTK libraries). No obfuscated code, dangerous commands (eval, base64, curl, wget in unexpected contexts), suspicious network requests, or unexpected file operations are present. The code is consistent with ordinary packaging practices for this type of application.
</details>
